[/p][p]If you missed part one make sure to check the addition of the new [b]Remote Speaker [/b]gadget.[/p][h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/518150/view/509583751892697703"][/dynamiclink][/h2][h2][b]Door Sounds & Slams[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/c14325615e64a7c4f409bc90483c7b3b955fac03.gif"][/img][/p][p]Adding to the sound strategies and aural experience in [b][i]Intruder[/i][/b], [i]doors will now make noise depending on how quickly or slowly they are opened.[/i][/p][p][b]Open fast[/b] and you can hear the latch and friction against the frame as the door opens. [/p][p][b]Close fast [/b]and you can hear the door slamming shut.[/p][p]These sounds project a decent distance and with different sounds depending on the door's material. If you keep your ears perked up, [b]you'll be able to hear when someone is in a hurry[/b]. If you're [b]trying to maintain your stealth[/b], make sure to open the doors more slowly. notes.title: Intruder: Timeline, Map & Gadget Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/f46f2247d7a59300ca7e284c1a33c1f0f53001d8.png[/img]
Greetings, Agents. We have an assortment of Intruder improvements going live today, which should not only improve your gameplay experience with specific weaponry, but on particular maps as well. Check out the full details below:
[h2]Steam Timeline[/h2]
Intruder now has Steam Timeline support! Record you mission gameplay with markers for key events.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/169817caca4d335727e2e36f926b2a4b9891e1ed.png[/img]
You can press [b]Shift + Tab[/b] to bring up Steam Timeline settings. There is even some potassium tracking added in.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/abf8b20c18e048ff55e25394c57b2bd4f285617e.png[/img]

[h2][b]Map & Gadget Updates[/b][/h2]

Shotgun slugs now deal a maximum of 65 damage up close, but still drops to a minimum 35 damage at range, which is an increase from the Hammerhead's previous 50 damage. You should notice the two-shot-to-kill drop-off starts at a greater range, as well, making the Hammerhead more lethal than ever in close-quarters battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/c826327faffb4199e08fa2a1639116ae9e97fa4a.gif[/img]
Smoke grenades now emit smoke faster, so they'll be more immediately useful as a tactical gadget. We've also updated the VFX for CS Gas, which now features a more visible colored haze indicating the affected area. Smoke and CS gadgets are also better synced, so you should no longer see their effect at the start of a round when joining a server.

We made some changes with distributing items, so take note that rooms with shortened round timers or fewer rounds/sets than default will no longer grant players XP.

We've also  made several updates to improve the gameplay experience on both Cliffside and Mountainside. You'll find changes to loadouts, fixes for known and new issues, and more. Additionally, the performance optimization [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/518150/view/4450214404346087439]introduced in Mountainside's launch[/url] now comes to Cliffside, so you should see an increased frame rate as a result of stronger occlusion culling processes.

For the full breakdown of each map's updates, check out the details below.

[h3][b]New Mountainside Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/217b38a474515b67ab1471604f62d548958b0707.png[/img]
[*] Guards no longer spawn with Dragon ARs. Loadouts have been reverted to Mantas.
[*] The door that leads from Classroom Hallway to Roof is locked and requires a keypad code to open. The codes are located in the Armory and inside the Roof Security Room.
[*] 3 Dragon ARs can be found inside the Main Building: Executive Office, Roof Security Room and Roof Storage
[*] The main zipline end point has been moved from the West Guard Booth Antenna to a tree right next to that booth
[*] Added extra bushes and cover along the end of the zipline near the West Guard Booth
[*] Added ladders onto the East and West Guard Booth
[*] Added glowsticks on the main bridge marking the zipline starting points
[*] Added an orange piece of cloth onto the Long Cliff Zipline to indicate you can grab it from jumping off the bridge.
[*] Added text on the sides of the East/West Booths.
[*] Slightly adjusted the position of the pickups in the Armory (pickups aren't as spread out)
[*] Fixed the Satellite Control Server Room server racks not having proper collision
[*] Fixed some ammo boxes slightly clipping into surfaces
[*] Fixed round reset Elevator desync
[*] Fixed round reset Attack Helicopter desync
[/list]

[h3][b]New Cliffside Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly adjusted Intruder spawn
[*] Added and adjusted cover near the Garage entrances to assist Intruders with defending Guard pushes and attacks
[*] Moved the Garage Shotgun closer to Intruder spawn
[*] Fixed the Cliff not slipping players
[*] Fixed a method to climb back into the Project Room ceiling vent
[*] Fixed multiple culling issues
[*] Fixed lighting on small props
[/list]
Lastly, maps are split into two uploads: Windows and Mac. This was done for Mountainside on release. Now, rather than a single map requiring 1gb for [i]each[/i] operating system, it's split 500mb/500mb for Windows/Mac to lighten the load.

[code][h3][b]DiD yOu KnOw ThAt!?[/b][/h3]The Falcon inside the Mountainside Armory has 5 extra bullets to compensate for the extra work required to unlock it (compared to grabbing the Dragon AR) for a total of 15 bullets.[/code]
Thank you to the members of Secret Base Alpha for their help testing updates like these. We appreciate you all. To share your own feedback, or apply to join Secret Base Alpha for future tests, join us on the [url=http://discord.gg/superbossgames]Intruder Discord server[/url]. Be sure to check out the all-new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/518150/view/783160409258460588]Dragon AR weapon[/url] and let us know what you think.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/518150/Intruder/]Get Intruder on Steam[/url] to check out the new update, and be sure to [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@superbossgames][b]follow Superboss Games on TikTok[/b][/url] and [url=https://bsky.app/profile/superbossgames.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url] for more content updates, community highlights, and more videos!

notes.title: FPS Fest Sale: Decoy Update & New Cosmetics Revealed
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/d7d8240e5bf992ccde9b83382c278513b896496b.png[/img]
Welcome, Agents.

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/action_fps]Steam FPS Fest[/url] has begun, and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/518150/Intruder/]Intruder is on sale for 50% off[/url][/b]! Our stealth multiplayer FPS is discounted during the entire event, which runs April 15th to April 22nd at 10am PT. For the duration of FPS Fest, you'll also earn a [b]200% XP bonus[/b] when playing Intruder!

As we celebrate all things FPS, we're excited to reveal new functionality for the Decoy gadget, as well as some shiny new cosmetic unlocks. We're also pleased to crown a new Intruder Competitive League Champion [i]and[/i] talk a little bit more about the Gloves item from April Fool's Day...

It's a big briefing, so let's get to it.

[h3]Gameplay Update: Decoy Crouch Stance[/h3]
The Decoy gadget has received new functionality to help you deceive even the most experienced of Intruder players. [b]The Decoy now has a crouch mode[/b] in addition to its default standing stance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/4400dcf7f36b79ba9d3e178662be9df581f66c47.png[/img]
The additional stance should further help you trick Guard snipers into wasting precious ammunition on a cardboard target, or force an Intruder to second-guess their infiltration route when spotting a supposed enemy. An alt Decoy stance has been a community feature request for a bit, so we're excited to see you bamboozle your opponents more effectively than ever. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/3c4d764c479bd3ae20b737bb088fa2722ff32376.gif[/img]
[i]The default key-bind for changing your Decoy's stance is [b]right-click/Mouse 2[/b] while holding the gadget![/i]

[h3]Intruder Competitive League 8 Championship[/h3]
[b]Congratulations to team OWL for claiming 1st Place during Intruder Competitive League 8![/b]
This was an exciting and menacing team throughout ICL8. Their precision play and lethal tactics made them a joy to watch -- and will make them a difficult team to dethrone in ICL9. 

To honor OWL's incredible performance, the team has been immortalized with a new Item Cache unlock: The [b]OWL Beret[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/a38de40f305f33b5365bbe4dd6450eb5455bbc2c.png[/img]
Got a light? This OWL-themed item features the team's stylish symbol adorning an equally stylish beret -- and it's astonishingly rare. If you happen to see this cosmetic in your matches this week...stay alert. That could very well be one of our Champion players from OWL -- they're getting the OWL Beret before anyone else.

Watch the OWL vs COC grand final series right here:
[previewyoutube=sutOZxrCtA8;full][/previewyoutube]
Don't miss [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q3nz3_74jtY]the battle for 3rd Place between ISEC and SD[/url] as well!

Congratulations again to OWL for an impressive season, and a hearty thank you to every team that participated in the ICL8 season. Watching your tense matches has been excellent. We look forward to seeing you compete again in the near future.

[h3]New Item: Silver Specter[/h3]
In addition to the all-new OWL Beret, we're unveiling another Item Cache unlockable for you, Agents. If you're looking to bring a sleek and modern metallic shine to your sidearm, look no further than the all-new [b]Silver Specter Panther[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/16294907deec1c21e71ed30feebf3c24c0f40d62.png[/img]
We've increased your chances of earning the Silver Specter during FPS Fest. After the event ends on April 22nd, the new Panther skin becomes a [b]Red Ultra Rare[/b] reward that's more difficult to obtain.

If you're eager to unlock the Silver Specter for your Item Cache, there's no time like the present.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/7ecac4704ea4d8a080d2017fcd115a8a20e5d074.gif[/img]
[i]The Silver Specter skin is another excellent addition to your arsenal courtesy of RandomPerson, the artist behind last winter's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/518150/announcements/detail/3865841447732696059?snr=2___]Reindeer Falcon[/url]! [/i]

[h3]Gloves[/h3]
HQ has been monitoring your enthusiasm for these new Advanced CQC tactics, and the conclusion is clear: The April Fool's Day Gloves item was a full-blown hit with the Intruder community. 

As promised in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/518150/view/4197991259837012463]Spring 2024 Update[/url], we're excited to add Gloves to the [url=https://wiki.superbossgames.com/wiki/index.php/IntruderMM]IntruderMM[/url] tools. Mapmakers can now add Gloves to their existing maps as an item pick-up (for use in addition to your hands). Or perhaps Mapmakers will build entirely new tactical arenas around the fearsome fist gadget. We look forward to all sorts of heavy-hitters the Intruder Mapmaking community will bring to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/518150/workshop/]Workshop[/url]!

Don't miss our favorite highlights of the Gloves in action: 

[previewyoutube=NEeAjRfnSR0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: SPRING 2024: Hand-to-Hand Combat Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/f07f8203a8e1b8aae7d69a8f529fab8cbfc864c5.png[/img]

Greetings, Agents. 

The clocks have changed, April Fool's has arrived, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/518150/Intruder/]Intruder[/url]'s Spring 2024 update is here -- and this one packs a punch. But, as the seasons change, it's not just goofs coming to your matches -- we've been working hard on a few things you've been asking about, and planting the seeds for Intruder's future. 

Before we dive in, we'd like to send our sincere congratulations to OWL for claiming 1st prize in the Intruder Competitive League Season 8. The competitive matches were exhilarating to watch, 

Let's dive into the update...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/bb2878974213b3160dedd83dec0f4d70120f8499.gif[/img]

[h3]Advanced CQC Gadget: Gloves[/h3]
Headquarters has authorized the temporary use of Advanced Close Quarters Combat tactics. Engage in Advanced CQC with the all new Gloves gadget, available for a limited time. 

We could brief you on this in detail, but it's safe to say this tactical gadget speaks for itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/46b790031ad42e90d3a808d6e975422180971bfe.gif[/img]

If you want to test the fit of your all-new Gloves, enter the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3208187362]Bill's Octagon map[/url] and kick off your very own cage fight. All players will be outfitted with Gloves on their hands for the duration of the Advanced CQC testing period (happy April Fool's, Agents).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/25d4c6fcef1ef28aeed65748969fb58d3a04b305.gif[/img]

Gloves will replace your hands by default for April Fool's -- but you can access them any time with the following match tuning setting:

[b]{
    "BoxingGlovesDefault": true
}[/b]

Gloves will be added to Intruder's Mapmaker at a later date. 

[h3]Laser Sensor Update[/h3]
Another tactical gadget improvement courtesy of headquarters: The Laser Sensor device has been upgraded. After your Laser Sensor sticks to a wall, a visible laser beam will briefly appear, indicating its detection path, and then fade out to conceal your gadget as usual.

On top of that, sensors stacked on top of each other should no longer misbehave (i.e. not triggering because they're blocking themselves).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/91a52d3ddc086093df6849b118273d2159db282a.gif[/img]

[h3]Experimental Linux Compatibility & Other Housekeeping[/h3]
Intruder is available to play on Linux through Proton. This is [b]experimental compatibility testing[/b] -- so we're looking forward to the results and your feedback (which you can share on [url=http://discord.gg/superbossgames]the official Superboss Games Discord server[/url]).

In addition to this, Intruder now has Rich Presence on Discord! This means your Intruder matches will show on your profile's Now Playing section -- allowing friends, teammates, and your boss to see when you're exfil'ing on Riverside.

Additionally, a pop-up message will now inform Demoted players of their status and the reasons for their Demotion. 

[h3]Improvements & Fixes[/h3]
The Superboss Games team has also been hard at work on various quality of life updates, many of which surfaced from community feedback (we appreciate you). While laying the groundwork in code for Intruder's future, we've also pushed fixes to map voting, round timer, and more. Here's the full list: 

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Better UI and HUD rendering, should now be pixel perfect and without alignment artifacts or missing lines
[*] Tons of weapon, projectile, damage, arrest, and inventory code refactoring and optimization, for getting ready for AI
[*] Projectile spawn point transform positioning and code
[*] Muzzle flash and gun tucking code changes
[*] Some first person animation performance enhancements
[*] Popups for demotion reasons when launching
[*] Activator game objects don't need to be active by default, this allows thunder on Oceanside
[*] Improved map name fuzzy search
[*] SlipZone script added and change to railing prefab for better slipping
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed laser sensors place on corners blocking each other and not triggering
[*] Fixed slowmo not resetting sometimes when loading maps
[*] Fixed map voting selecting the wrong map when voting F1
[*] Fixed round timer starting without anyone joining a team or specs
[*] Fixed round timer appearing or not at the wrong times/settings
[*] Fixed lifecheck bugs

notes.title: Update 2663: Upgrading Existing Systems
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/e20dd3528aea58fa296a94103be989eac84e9152.png[/img]
Greetings Agents, and welcome to Update 2663! We've taken some time and looked at player feedback to see what some pain points were for agents, and we have some upgrades to our underlying systems that should make the game more fluid and fun for everyone.

[h3]CS Gas[/h3]

With our new CS Gas system in place, agents were quick to point out how some objects were blocking gas when they shouldn't have. We've done a pass on official maps and tweaked some details in order to make sure that small or permeable objects like vents, rails, lockers, etc. don't block gas anymore. 

Small objects in rooms like tables and chairs will also not block gas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/2c12d6fe941e65ec856bc82b76d1de786f842112.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/3c4f9e30fd09a2304f6abe1d1daea5de72c26ca8.png[/img]

The best strategy then is to throw your CS grenades into the middle of the room you are trying to clear.

For Map Makers, you can use the GasCollisionSettings.cs component to set whether gas should pass through certain objects or not. Most are found automatically however!

[h3]Medkit Usage[/h3]

Agents have been liking the new medkits, and we've seen multiple games won due to medkit usage! It's polite to thank your medic, but we made a faux pas by not thanking them on our end with XP points. Going forward The medic will receive 30 XP for healing a wounded player, while the wounded player gets 20 XP for being a good patient. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/b009da262e742de9e078972d9b1e4dd4c4437d79.png[/img]

[h3]Explosive Anti-Launch measures[/h3]

We've seen explosives launch agents to all sorts of weird places they shouldn't be, and unfortunately our preventative measures have been to harsh in some cases while being too lenient in others. We've toned down the instant-kill function to prevent launches so you should be killed by standard rigs much less frequently. In order to combat this, we have added a new system called [b]Anti-Launch Zones[/b] which will kill agents who launch themselves through them with explosives. This system is also available to mapmakers which should allow them to prevent agents from launching to higher floors without needing to add dedicated Death Zones to their maps.

This will be available in the new Map Maker package going up today.

[h3]Bloon Gun for Mapmakers[/h3]

The infamous Bloon Gun gadget is now available for mapmakers to add to their custom maps. Whether you plan on making a map tailored to the gadget, or enjoy the chaos it causes, you can make death rain from above once again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/b83a9e723ae382a8f025db4682b8d661da5e9f81.png[/img]

[h3]Intruder Competitive league[/h3]

With the returning champions, HOLY, being knocked out in the playoffs a familiar face took the trophy home during ICL Season 6. ISEC took home the victory by defeating BOIS in the championship match with DD not far behind in 3rd place. Rewards will be going out to all the teams, but there is a special reward for all ISEC members!

The Panther - ISEC will be available as an Ultra-Rare unlock in game. Featuring a classic Khokhloma design with gold inlay featuring the ISEC logo, this skin took some extra time, love and care to put together and we hope it was worth the wait!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/020a168e4c625eb98bdbb8dcad5ad0135339c5b0.png[/img]
[url=https://intruderfps.com/chat]Interested in learning more about the ICL? Join the discord and check it out![/url]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]

A few minor updates and bugfixes also came out in this update, so take a look and see if you noticed them!
[list]
[*] Player Level and XP being inconsistent across the game and the website was addressed and now both are synced correctly.
[*] Mountainside light blob near East Bridge removed.
[*] Add toggle to only show selected maps in create lobby menu.
[*] Limit max fps during intro screen.
[*] Cliffside Deathzones added to some glitch spots.
[*] Oceanside ceiling and vent fixes
[/list]
[url=https://intruderfps.com/chat]Well, did you notice any of those bugs? If so you should check out our Beta Testing group [b]Secret Base Alpha[/b] in our Discord![/url]

Players can only be healed once per round, so maybe hold off on healing that teammate who has 95 HP... or heal them anyways. I'm not the medic, you are!
[/code]

notes.title: Update 2335: New Sounds, Map Changes, & Effects!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/00fb6179c6849e0a1801ac286a05692113db01b1.png[/img]

Greetings agents, and welcome to update 2335! Listen up, because this update focuses on some key aspects of sneaking around in Intruder including sounds, glass, map updates, and more!

[h3]General Updates[/h3]

These are changes that don't pertain to a specific map or were not big enough to warrant their own section, but are still good to know about.

[list]
[*] Notes - Notes now display text and can be read from a distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/2ff40e397c48426e5332c865cc85d0e4d6a30522.gif[/img]

[*] Decoys - Decoys can now be placed much faster (1.5 -> 0.55 second cooldown).
[*] Armor - Armor walking noises have been reduced in volume by 15%.
[*] Hack Terminals - Terminals now have more text and flavor text when hacking. If the terminal transmits to a status monitor, an additional transmitting graphic has been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/f3e03822cc852c86655ed174ebc5c591dcdb5dd9.gif[/img]

[*] Mapmaker - Mapmakers can now allow falling package captures, add a cooldown between activator activations, enable unity events for terminal hacks, and add the transmitting graphics to terminals.
[/list]

[h3]Glass[/h3]

Whether or not you prefer to shoot, blast, or punch your way through glass, this update brings about some major changes to how glass works in Intruder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/edbdece433671a8cc29f5bc718c4422db0ce001f.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Glass particles now have updated graphics to look more like real shards of glass.
[*] Glass particles are now discrete and physical objects which means they will no longer fall through floors and interact with the environment accordingly.
[*] Glass now has a different pitch when it breaks depending on the size of the pane.
[/list]

[h3]Sounds[/h3]

For a game where silently sneaking past your opponents and listening in on conversations is a pivotal part of the experience, we noticed that Intruder felt a bit empty in terms of sound and have brought in some new sounds for your listening pleasure!

[b]Spatial Sounds[/b]

These new sounds can be heard by everyone around you, so listen in to try and gain intel on the enemy!

[list]
[*] Grenade Impact - CS, Smoke, and Concussion Grenades now make noise when bouncing off of surfaces.
[*] Laser sensor - Now makes a noise when sticking to a surface.
[*] Shield - Now makes noises when falling down after being knocked out of someone's hands.
[*] Package - Dropping a package off your back now makes a noise as it hits the floor.
[*] Banana - How loud is a banana peel falling on the floor? Now you can find out as bananas now make noise on impact!
[*] Cardboard Decoy - Decoys landing on the floor now make noise.
[*] Hack Terminals - All terminals now have a fan noise that is audible when nearby.
[*] Hacking - Hack terminals now use mechanical keyboards and HDD's that make noise when hacking.
[*] Smoke - Smoke grenades now make noise as the smoke is released from the canister.
[*] Bullet Casings - Discarded shells now make noise as they bounce around.
[/list]

[b]First Person Sounds[/b]

These new sounds can only be heard by the player making them, so don't feel like you have to be completely silent all the time.

[list]
[*] Equipping Guns - All guns have unique equip sounds.
[*] Equipping Gadgets - Most gadgets now make a standard equip sound.
[*] Pickups - Armor and Guns now make a unique sound when being picked up.
[*] Deployment - Deploying the Cardboard Decoy or Banana now makes a unique sound.
[*] Fire Selector - Changing the firing mode of the Manta now makes a distinct click.
[/list]

[h3]Map Updates[/h3]

We also have some new features on your favorite Official Maps!

[b]Riverside[/b]

Some major changes have come to Riverside, but overall it's still the map you know and love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/4e083967cf282728f125fad9a654c911a79f89eb.gif[/img]

[u]Gameplay Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Windows - Glass has been added to all openings, and now each pane breaks individually rather than in groups.
[*] Garden - A new fence and denser vegetation should make it easier for an intruder to sneak through.
[*] Map limits - You no longer die by wandering too far out of bounds, and some trucks have been added on the side of the road to denote the limit.
[*] Non-Shootable Light - A non-shootable light has been added to the Bathroom Hall in B2 to illuminate players by the slit windows.
[*] Shootable lights - New shootable lights added to Lab B and Garage hall. Shootable lights now have different texture than non-shootable lights
[*] Shutters - Shutters have been added to most of the northern windows on the main floor of B2. These are fully penetrable by all bullets, and can be opened/closed with a switch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/98cc40c955dd9b53696985db13fc846ec3a39a54.gif[/img]
[/list]

[u]Graphics and Bugfixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Garbage cans - Added to B2 bathrooms so y'all can throw away your trash.
[*] B2 Roof - The Bloon Cam no longer pops when flying over the roof of B2.
[*] Graphics - Added frames to some openings, fixed some textures, fixed some lighting, and resolved some occlusion issues.
[/list]

[b]Cliffside[/b]

Cliffside has some minor changes to the map itself, but some big changes have come to Cliffside Raid!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/8f74c82450eaac38a68aabe1dccac989dce4807f.gif[/img]

[u]Gameplay Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Windows - Glass has been added to all openings, and now each pane breaks individually rather than in groups. All windows that do not have a usable ledge underneath have been made slippery.
[*] Cliffside Raid - The package locations have been moved a bit deeper into the rooms they are in, and a new extract has been added all the way down on the desert floor. 
[/list]

[u]Graphics and Bugfixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Graphics - Fixed some textures and some lighting.
[*] Sticky Spots - Floor length windows have been fixed so you should no longer get stuck when trying to run through the empty panes.
[/list]

[b]Mountainside[/b]

Most changes were bugfixes or graphical changes, but a few changes have been made to help newer players as well.

[u]Gameplay Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Ziplines - The zipline from the bridge booth to the cliffs has been made a bit easier to get on, and a rock has been added at the end of the garden zipline to prevent you from sliding into the ocean.
[*] Falcon Code - A note has been placed next to the Falcon that explains where to find the code.
[*] Windows - Glass has been added to all openings, and now each pane breaks individually rather than in groups. Bathroom windows slide open for silent entry.
[/list]

[u]Graphics and Bugfixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Booths - Added green lights to guard booths, and added red lights and shutters to mountain tunnels.
[*] Collision - Fixed a spot on pipes where the collision did not align with the model.
[*] Graphics - Fixed some textures and some lighting.
[/list]

[b]All Official Maps[/b]

A few changes were made across all official maps, so check them out below!

[list]
[*] Doors - Doors should no longer push players into walls.
[*] Misaligned or floating objects - Many objects were moved to properly line up, which eliminates gaps, clipping, and other issues.
[*] Clocks - Clocks now have updated models and move in sync with game time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/8c47af3b1c8a2bf142deee731d2bfc65c40fd591.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]

As always, we are fixing bugs as often as possible. You can see some of the recent fixes below.

[list]
[*] Smoke should no longer pass through surfaces as much as it has in the past.
[*] Smoke and CS gas no longer work under water.
[*] Laser Sensors no longer endlessly beep if someone is stationary in front of them.
[*] Stumbling on a slippery surface should no longer spam the slipping noise.
[*] Falcon Scope no longer gets washed out when in a bright light.
[*] Corrected textures, updated texture resolutions, and fixed lighting on certain objects.
[*] Back to back glass panes should both crack when shot through with a single bullet.
[*] Can no longer have multiple players hack the same terminal for double hacks. Players can still simultaneously hack different terminals within the same group.
[*] Can no longer hack after round end. 
[*] Bullet impact effects no longer float in the air if the object they were on is picked up.
[*] Taking a picture with the Bloon Cam at the same frame a round ends no longer breaks the HUD.
[*] Breaking glass and switching weapons simultaneously no longer locks your mouse or prevents you from changing weapons.
[*] Multiple sounds have been cleaned up and optimized.
[/list]

[code][h3][b]DiD yOu KnOw ThAt!?[/b][/h3] You can use the SEND functionality of the Binoculars to silently send codes to your teammates![/code]

Thanks again to all the dedicated agents of Secret Base Alpha who tirelessly test these updates before they are ready to go live. notes.title: Update 2165: New Map Maker, Room Options & More!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/a4cd2b7ff75c2780d4973f0a80ba09c69711b5b8.png[/img]

Attention, Agents! 

It’s been a while since the last update, but don’t worry, there is a lot coming your way very soon! With so much up and coming, we are very excited to show you a little of what we have been working on!

[h1]Mapmaker Update:[/h1]
We have been hard at work on a brand new update for our [b]Map Maker version 2.08[/b], which will allow you to use custom items. A great example will be the new keycard system we have teased recently in our [url=https://discord.gg/superbossgames]Discord[/url], that we plan to use on our upcoming map, Checkpoint!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zbvmjeh.gif[/img]

With this update, you will be able to insert custom items in game (like the keycard), linked to a special script allowing you to put said item in your inventory, and even to have an inventory icon for it.

The custom item you add will allow you to enable scripts, such as an activator, and it can also help you create custom game modes, such as needing a certain item to complete a goal on the map!

These items will not drop on death, and you’ll be able to make as many as 10 different custom objects per map, leaving you plenty of room to create some interesting systems!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/60b2f0e0bcf67b786569376e4c18b6b27881ab1f.png[/img]
[i]A keycard on one of Checkpoint’s Desks![/i]

[h1]New Room Creation Menu:[/h1]
This update will bring a brand new room creation menu, with a lot (and we mean, a lot!) of requested settings from the community! You can now choose the number of rounds to win a set, and number of sets to win a match, for shorter or extra long matches. The new menu includes a new region selector, a ping limitation setting (rooms with different ping limites will have a notification), custom team names for clan matches, and much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/f6f4e6cba6983c0daf27a9c02e906705f53f58a8.png[/img]

[h1]Tie Breaker System:[/h1]
We’re also glad to introduce a brand new feature for Intruder, a new tie breaker option for the game! This was heavily requested by our competitive community, and we are happy to announce that it can now be enabled in all servers and private rooms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/557f62f81317ce7a5f1b91f75d2a0d5764312431.png[/img]

Now, this might appear convoluted, but the main difference is; The tie breaker set is no longer decided by a single round (on a random side). Instead you must win by two consecutive rounds, one as guards and one as intruders.

This will ensure your team is good as both intruders and guards, and helps balance out maps or game modes which may be slightly intruder-sided or guard-sided.

By default, the option will be off on every server, so if you like the current Intruder experience, no need to change anything and continue on as normal.

[h1]Cliffside 2.0:[/h1]
As shown in a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/518150/view/3104665083325383382]previous update[/url], Cliffside is getting a complete overhaul, and we are super excited to show you how it is coming along!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/786cf30ad1d046b8a8ca88574191f3b5bf9d6bb9.png[/img]
[i]The new conference room[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/5d9188b478a1095d8809da38c49c4f3aaeb142af.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/027f25108b0b953bdf88a60eedc7ab4245e34a68.png[/img]

One of the most requested features by the game’s community has always been AI and PvE, and well, it’s finally time to introduce you to the game AI for the first time! While it is still very early in development and a work in progress, we’re stoked to show you some teasers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/eb360c0e539e51a2d88c79cdb89623b66d6b700e.png[/img]
[i]The nav mesh used by the AI to navigate on the map and the path nodes[/i]

We’re currently focusing on guard AI, who will patrol around the map, set rigs and search for players when seen or heard. The AI can even hear your voice if you’re not quiet. It’s been a while without updates about the map, so here’s a few screenshots to tease a little bit more, but more information is around the corner!

notes.title: Update 2094: Engine & Performance Upgrade & more!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/6a1d8fcb062039cbd2b2179f3a129a51d1f7c59f.jpg[/img]

Hello agents and welcome to Update 2094! This build brings Intruder up to date with Unity 2020, allowing for more optimized gameplay and more tools for mapmakers!

[h3]Unity 2020[/h3]

Some of our most dedicated agents remember our change from using Unity 4 to Unity 5 many years ago, but going to Unity 2020 has been an enormous undertaking that we couldn't have done without the support from all of our new agents! Take a look below to see some of the improvements that will make Intruder better than ever.

[b][u]Optimization:[/u][/b]

Even though Intruder isn't a game that requires a top notch gaming machine, we want to make sure that our agents with older equipment can still hold their own in a battle! We've made many changes under the hood, so while it may not seem like much has changed, many agents will see noticeable improvements in the game's performance and framerate! OSX has also been moved over to the Metal API, with some players getting double the FPS on official maps.

[b][u]Lighting:[/u][/b]

Sneak through the shadows with new lighting for all official maps! Find all the hidden spots during the night or stick to the shadows in the day to take full advantage of the new lighting system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/57e6333841131b2e025b7ab2a490167c2fae5e70.gif[/img]

The new light mapping systems also allow us to bake new versions of the scenes faster than ever. Map makers can take advantage of this GPU-based lightmapping as well!

[b][u]Custom Lobby Player Limits:[/u][/b]

Some maps are small, and others are big, and 5 agents isn't always the optimal team. Now you can choose how many agents can join your custom lobby! You can set the "Max Agents" to any whole number between 2 and 20 in order to make small 1v1 fights or even 10v10 battles. You can even do a 20 agent Last Man Standing lobby!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/4e8bfce2d1b9235878b515221cba2d1ce6e27a7a.png[/img]

[h3]Quality of Life Changes[/h3]

As always, we strive to make Intruder more fun and fair to play. These changes focus on feedback which we have received from agents like you!

[b][u]Changes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Very big optimizations on spectator view should get you the max frames to capture those cinema quality moments!
[*] Practice rounds are only 60 seconds so players don't have to wait for a whole round to end on larger maps.
[/list]

[b][u]Bugfixes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Many fixes behind the scenes to get everything in tip top shape for Unity 2020
[*] Standard Water Asset fixed for mapmakers
[*] Balance damage values corrected in the tutorial
[*] Fixed bug with "C4 jumping"
[*] Room filter no longer saves between sessions
[*] Better microphone compatibility for Windows and OSX!
[/list]

[h3]Map Maker[/h3]

The Intruder Map Maker has been updated to work with the new unity version which has new tools and an upgraded Sabre CSG version to allow mapmakers to truly unlock their full potential! If you're interested in making a map, want to show off your new map, or need help with the map making process, join us on [url=https://intruderfps.com/chat]Discord[/url] to chat with our community!

[b][u]WARNING TO ALL PLAYERS AND MAPPERS:[/u][/b] Some custom maps might not be compatible with the new version of the Unity Engine. You will see a yellow text chat warning if you're on an older map. If you have a map upload onto the Steam Workshop, or a map that's a work-in-progress, please join the SuperbossGames [url=https://intruderfps.com/chat]Discord[/url] server and follow this [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/19zynfmjAr73eqSQ04W8mXHxq12SYC2-kgFwHRatb5g0]guide[/url] in order to update your map properly.

notes.title: UPDATE 1945: RADIAL MENU & Gameplay Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/35bb84f7321daeccc7c45b7e1e42a59cc725a61e.png[/img]
Hello Agents and welcome to Intruder update 1945! In this update we finally bring in the long asked for, much desired radial menu system. And it comes in a few flavors. We've also got gameplay updates and a new damage drop-off system. Let's check it all out!

[h2]Radial menu
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/06a8d6c2585166d083fb0813057d0573fd7f4f9c.gif[/img]
[b]WARNING: The new radial menu system has added a few new keybinds to your settings. To make sure there are no conflicts, your keybinds will be reset the first time you start the game again.[/b]

Sick of reaching across the keyboard with your other hand to equip the lock pick or cardboard decoy? Sick of rebinding different equipment when you pick up something new or change maps? With the new pack radial menu, you'll never have to reach or rebind again! The pack radial menu has been defaulted to the Middle Mouse button and the G key. There are two ways to use it.
[list]
[*] [b]Tap [/b]middle mouse/g and let go. Move your mouse in the direction of the item you want and click to equip.
[*] [b]Faster: Hold[/b] middle mouse/g and drag towards the item you want, let go to equip.
[/list]
There are two types of radial menus available for your equipment.
[list]
[*] Pack radial: shows all equipment in your pack/inventory
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/1695c2c1e6ca180159de35772e6a2b44e33d976f.png[/img]
[*] Slot radial: shows equipment bound to the classic number slots system only
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/ab41b59cf8b5f9acad5b18e9bbea64b93543fd06.png[/img]
[/list]
We think the pack radial is the best choice, but you can mix and match all of the systems how it works best for you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/0ea63d3a9fed6b822f072af7238a3aabbbe8667a.gif[/img]
[i]Rigging is much faster with the radial menu[/i]

NOTE: If you'd like to forego the radial system altogether, you can bind your binds just like you always did and it will still work as normal!

[h2]Front, Back, Holster binds
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/a337beaffbd01b42dc5e48762fd0ee3e109e4826.png[/img]
There are 3 other new equipment binds as well for the Front item, Back item, and Holster (pistol) item. These binds mean when you pick up a sniper rifle, shield, shotgun etc. you will no longer need to bind them again from the inventory menu. By default Front, Back, and Holster are bound to the 1, 2, and 3 keys. Since those keys are easy to reach, you also have the option to show/hide them on your radial menus. Here's the difference:

WITH Front, Back, Holster:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/18cbef4183ca2e108736b1ff991576428a13eff9.png[/img]
WITHOUT Front, Back, Holster:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/400683e24f958277299b6eccf17f399667343558.png[/img]

Make sure to check your radial menu options in the general tab of the options menu. The radial menu will be brought to other features in the future, like hand signals and ammo changes, so keep an eye out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/acb35f801b55cbe5958b39b394913d0c85e418ff.png[/img]

[h2]Shotgun Slug adjustments & Damage drop-off
[/h2]
Last update we introduce the shotgun slug ammo type. While the lethal new addition to shotgun is a lot of fun, there was valid concern that it could be pretty powerful, maybe too powerful, maybe a bit OP is what we're saying. To keep the fun parts while mitigating the overpowered parts, we've introduced a totally new damage drop-off system. Currently this is only applied to the shotgun slug, but is usable for other projectiles in the future as well.

The damage drop-off system can apply to all damage types: base damage, balance, and energy. Here are some graphs of the shotgun slug damage drop-offs. Notice that it is still powerful at very close ranges, but will no longer be a 2 shot kill after a small distance.

[b]Shotgun Slug BASE DAMAGE:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/fa9f93edf0985a11bcad9e3a7f95509691249a1b.png[/img]
[b]Shotgun Slug BALANCE DAMAGE:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/1b5a37f57b197682a4056bec64d8433b457c0045.png[/img]
[b]X: Distance in Meters, Y: Damage[/b]

How would you apply damage drop-off in the future and what gun types does this make more viable?

We're also working on a new buckshot ammo type to help fulfill the shotgun's role as a room clearing device. Right now it's working and feeling nice, but we definitely want to test it a bit more before release. With the buckshot, the new radial menu will be integral in switching ammo types.

[h2]Changes & Additions
[/h2]
Several gameplay changes have been made which may seem subtle, but we hope take your tactics to a higher level.
[list]
[*] Grenade colliders made smaller and more consistent so you can now through them through gaps like the doorway glass when room clearing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/0f4360e873188cc33b31eae283e26014e5d6cb1e.gif[/img]
[*] Default equipment now has 1 concussion grenade instead of 2 to prevent grenade spam.
[*] SMG balance damage has been lowered slightly to reward those keeping high balance and moving slow in gun fights. Previously SMG was almost guaranteed two shot knock down in most stances.
[*] Balance is slightly slower to gain than to deplete.
[*] Front and back items can be position swapped by dragging on top of each other
[*] Shotgun slug now has blood effect
[*] Main menu popups can have timers before you can click buttons to hope that you reeeeeead them!
[*] Tutorial updated to reflect radial menu addition and changes
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ignoring controller stick input for now to avoid "Right Stick Down" down bug some people were getting
[*] Fix for red dot on shield bug
[*] Keybinds will reset if you accidentally mess them up and have duplicate keys bound
[*] Riverside B1 Hack shutters shadow fix
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1900: Lethal Shotgun & SMG Upgrades!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/6c3e6527ec9ce84c96d44aca7b60a555950cb6d7.png[/img]
Hello agents and welcome to update 1900! This update is all about the arsenal at your disposal with new models, new unlocks, new shotgun abilities, and more!

[h3]The Manta[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/3e3cc59166c2d29e29ab74f8009dadf6689b10c4.jpg[/img]

Meet the Manta, a compact submachine gun capable of taking out multiple enemies at close to medium range. The new iron sights make for a clean sight picture, but you can also attach the newly modeled red dot sight along with it for those longer range engagements! Use the fire selector to choose between single shot, burst, or automatic fire modes to adapt to the situation at hand. 

[b]New, clearer sights:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/1c91fb286a6789df3df9e6d3089bc924a4d8234e.gif[/img]

The Manta also features weapon skins that can be traded or sold on the community market! These skins include rare patterns as well as sleek colors. If you've been around long enough, you might even remember the classic white color that the Manta used to have!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/ac8130569711380e0d171583bb850ca2e0d72328.jpg[/img]

[h3]Shotgun Upgrade - Lethal Slugs & Red dots[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/769f38f0bdb1c483b4029a3c7467833f67408760.gif[/img]

You may recall picking up the beanbag shotgun, or maybe you thought of it as more of a novelty rather than a tactical weapon. Well, today the intruders received clearance to use lethal force and have replaced all beanbag rounds with lead slugs! 

[list]
[*] New slug ammo, 50 damage, 100 balance damage, 50 energy damage
[*] Can equip red dots
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/4779f2408ded0c1988cc9f29918fb5e2cfa62aaf.gif[/img]
[*] Slugs have higher velocity and door penetration at close range
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/62d3c0b32fad94d1de37a048575e40b5a7d4690b.gif[/img]
[*] Slightly faster reload time
[/list]

During testing, the intruders found that the slugs allow for a slightly faster reload, fly faster, and pack a nasty punch. You can even shoot through doors if you're less than 20 feet away from it!

Now I'm sure an intruder with a keen eye like yourself had to have noticed the red dot in that clip up above! With the slugs increasing the range on the shotgun, it only makes sense to allow the red dot to be equipped on it as well. Use it to take out enemies at longer ranges, but make sure you account for bullet drop since these slugs travel slower than most other bullets. 

[h3]The Item Cache and Item Exchange[/h3]

The Item Cache has been updated to more clearly show the rarities of your items and now groups your items by type. The biggest change, however, is the addition of item exchanges!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/5934170efa2e0b7667caf104f8586dc1d719c23c.gif[/img]

In basic training, intruders learn to sneak silently without leaving any footprints, and now they are making an effort to reduce their carbon footprint! With the item exchange, there will be no more wasted items as all agents can upcycle 5 items to create a similar item of higher rarity! Now you don't have to feel bad for your landfill full of common items and instead worry about what you are going to do with your pile of uncommon items... 

[h3]Unlockable Items[/h3]

You already saw a few of the new skins for the Manta, but there are more items that dropped with this update too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/6ed8a4d77972f34b261fa03b7da9f54680163828.jpg[/img]

[*] [b] And one wall tag that is swimming around somewhere...[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1854: Riverside B1 Hack-Asymmetry, 20 player Mountainside!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/5b095878cf1b446dc007dbd1a3de3b27609cb865.png[/img]

Hello agents and welcome to update 1854! This update brings [b]hack mode to Riverside for the first time ever[/b]! It's the most [b]asymmetrical [/b]and challenging mode ever on the map. We've also got [b]20 player Mountainside rooms[/b] up for testing, and more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/eeefe367bef0d21b665a63957c863451a3b02a49.gif[/img]

[h3]Riverside: B1 Hack - an asymmetrical assault[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/fd8b211d63809da7476d893bb9ea963c089d5938.png[/img]

The guards have gone digital! Instead of guarding a physical package, the guards now have to guard digital files... on physical terminals. Luckily, B1 has also been updated to include shutters and other security systems that can be used to block off access to any intruders! If the intruders hack 3 of the 4 computer networks, however, they have all the intel they need and can consider their mission a success!

[h3]Upgraded security room[/h3]

As seen in the picture above. The security room in B1 Hack has received a big upgrade. The large buttons on the security desk till activate shutters on the garden side of Building 1. Guards will need to use these new tools if they plan to win!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/eeefe367bef0d21b665a63957c863451a3b02a49.gif[/img]
[b]There are 2 shutters to close from the security room:
[/b][list]
[*] Upper Hall Window - Prevent intruders from seeing through the 2nd floor hall from garden rocks
[*] Front Entrance Windows - Prevent intruders from breaking in at the ground level
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/48242a55fd8860934d4027276f040ec2f17aa3a6.png[/img]

[b]Hack Monitor:[/b]
The new hack monitor board will help the security Guard know which networks have been hacked throughout the building. As a network gets hacked, its screen will change from blue to green.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/bdf912826179d77e79113dfea81ba81b943cbfdf.png[/img]

[b]Other permanent shutters:[/b]
You'll notice that Building 1 has been locked down by the guards more than ever. Because of this, certain routes are no longer valid, while others have gained significant importance.
[list]
[*] Skylight Windows - Prevent intruders from dropping in through the roof
[*] Rafter Windows - Prevent intruders from sneaking in from the top of the bridge
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/32c2d1b386e69c1cdc0456ed2540425e1989ba96.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/a7e7cadfea10526f32fd3a12acfffdeb14fc6815.png[/img]

[b]There are 4 networks to hack:
[/b][list]
[*] Alpha - Work Area A, Break room - 6 Hacks
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/f8d78a8f1e16ada642c5b4ca643c4bbb50449ecf.jpg[/img]
[*] Bravo - Conference room (2), Janitor's Closet - 10 Hacks
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/c27357f322ae88661d3620d66e07c262f1d1c42f.png[/img]
[*] Charlie - Front Desk, Waiting Area - 6 Hacks
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/348b99779228d2bca330f72fb6061c3e595116c3.png[/img]
[*] Delta - Security (2), Print Room, Office 3, Executive Office
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/059d3ee6998e73b10faf6c14f82c5b7d2683a724.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Asymmetrical Equipment[/h3]

Guard and Intruder on Riverside Hack B1 have very different equipment sets this time around. Many player wanted to try more asymmetrical game modes so this seemed like the perfect mode to try it out. On both teams you will notice the ammo is much more limited. Conserve your bullets and shoot only when needed!

[b]Guard Equipment:[/b]

All guards start with a Shotgun as primary and Shrike pistol. They lack concussion grenades and smoke grenades, but have a CS Gas.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/9966479fc7c6120df44d583cee112f014e5b47d9.png[/img]
For extra firepower. Guards have 2 SMGs available in the security room. Make sure to use them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/742c25506f2642d5e47c45b1dcdb0e445b5dfb79.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/d96ac1b35b04216a641b295fe4ffc87bd1632d3e.gif[/img]

Sick of getting shield rushed? This bulletproof gadget has been a favorite for many players, but may have proved a bit too powerful. We wanted to take away some of the single-sided advantage that the shield gives with these updates:

[list]
[*] Equip Times: It now takes longer to equip/unequip the Riot Shield. This should encourage players to commit to the shield and rely on teamwork to take out enemies they encounter while using the shield.
[*] Usability: While the riot shield was never allowed while prone, it will no longer be allowed while swimming or climbing ladders. 
[/list] 

The Riot Shield still retains its ability to block explosives and remains vulnerable to pushes. In fact, it should be safer to push over someone with a shield as they're less likely to swap to another weapon before you can close the gap.

Hello agents and welcome to update 1803! With it, another gadget has been added to the Intruder arsenal. We're very excited to introduce the [b]Bloon Cam, a flying, photo capable reconnaissance tool that will send your tactics soaring to a whole new level.[/b]

[h3]Bloon Cam[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/e98aa39478877c09eacacf796df17c0c54f34bc0.png[/img]

Equip and deploy the Bloon Cam in the same way you would use remote charges, sensors, or other throwables. To toggle on Bloon's camera view, simply right click while it's equipped. Bloon can move forward, backwards, strafe, and turn using the typical directional button (WASD) and the mouse. You can also fly Bloon up or down using the lean keys or using the jump or crouch keys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/e2ded446a50e0f53436d2ddffb3458d5fb121eab.gif[/img]

[b]Pressing fire/left-click while piloting will have Bloon snap of photo[/b] from its position and send that to all of your teammates. Like the binoculars photos, these will appear in the lower right HUD of all your teammates.

Besides being used as a recon tool, Bloon can also be used as an impromptu security camera. As a guard, leave Bloon by a briefcase room to check up on it from time to time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/22c20a444961a72ce381d08d68e9d9f2592a0a87.gif[/img]

Bloon has some other interesting capabilities that we hope you explore. We'll have a more detailed video of Bloon and what it can do during a future update! Until then, we wanted to get this awesome gadget in people's hands and see what new strategies emerge.

notes.title: Update 1757 & SALE - 50% off, Unlocks, Item Cache, Physics, and MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/40b4b1abb4f01616e2aa8aba0e489c7986203a11.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=hCcgmK28Rw4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Greetings Agents and welcome to Intruder update build number 1757![/b][/h3]
(edit: now 1759!)

[h3][b]Our first sale!![/b][/h3]

This is the first time since Intruder's early access release that we have gone on sale! For the next week we will be [b]%50 percent off![/b] We're excited for this update and wanted to make sure it was more easily available for anybody looking for some stealth action.

[h3][b]The Update[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/f902b1d630c6319825ace7989513b55c653de0d9.gif[/img]

This update is a big one, so let's break it down before we get started. First up is player progression. While levels have been introduced in a previous update, now you have something to look forward to with level rewards and the Item Cache! Next, the Intruders stepped up their game and now have a new version of their pistol codenamed The Panther. We also have a new and improved physics system for ragdolls, grenades, and other environment objects. Finally, we have some updates for the Intruder Map Maker which helps you make the game better for everyone else! Enough waiting around, it's time to dive in!

[h2][i]Progression System[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/c1f3d2db6b68ee719aedfb1b043f3458fa9c14c0.gif[/img]

Last time we sent you an update you saw the player progression system with XP and leveling. After each match you are awarded XP and level increases in the match summary screen. On top of that, you now acquire new items to add to your Item Cache. Some levels have preset rewards, but others are completely random, so be on the lookout for rare items!

[h2][i]Item Cache[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/fd4fcefbd8719921a8fa8c720ed957cdba20d8b6.gif[/img]

Now that you're unlocking items for playing Intruder, you ought to be able to do something with them! That's where the Item Cache comes in. You can access your Item Cache in game on either the main menu, or from the team select menu when you join a match. Clicking on an Item in the cache brings it up in the inspection viewer so you can get a good look at what you'll be bringing to your next fight. After previewing, you can equip and unequip your items which you might need to do often as there are plenty to choose from!

[h3][i]Item Types[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*]Skin - New weapon designs available for the Shrike and Panther
[*]Reticle - New reticles available for the red dot and the sniper scope
[*]Charge Sound - New sounds for when you detonate your explosive charges
[*]Sensor Sound - New sounds for when someone sets off your motion sensor
[*]Arm Patch - Patches for your character to show off your level
[*]Wall Tag - Decals that can be applied to walls, floors, ceilings, and more
[*]Hat - New hats to wear on your head
[*]HQ Background - Backgrounds to display when you're at the HQ
[*]Profile Background - Backgrounds to display on your player profile
[/list]

You'll also notice that the room creation menu has some new options available. This new Item cache dropdown let’s you determine what items types are available for use in your room. You can choose what to allow in your room so you can go all out for some zany action or keep it plain for some competitive play.

The item cache was implemented using Steam's inventory system. This makes it really easy for us to add new items or change details on existing ones. The four tiers are Blue, Green, Orange, and Purple which have rarities common, uncommon, rare, and very rare respectively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/1c362497c563693e217bd3dc9dcc70dc9477c0f8.gif[/img]

Another benefit of Steam is that the items you've acquired are open for trading and for sale in the marketplace. Members of secret base alpha have already been trading items during testing and it's been a ton of fun!

[h2][i]The Panther[/i][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/dcc8cfd66ec31c69eab6b0a479e15ae96d633f41.jpg[/img]

The Panther is the updated pistol used by the intruders. It not only looks better, but works better too! The suppressor has been slimmed down allowing for a clearer sight picture! It also has weapon skins so be sure to unlock, trade, or even buy the skins so you can start out in style. Thank you Jake, Brayan, and Martino  for the awesome art and technical work. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/bb4547fff19f7061e24e3484f4b84465901465b3.gif[/img]

[h2][i]Ragdoll Syncing[/i][/h2]
Ragdolls are now synced more accurately for all players. Previously ragdolls were pretty accurate, but in certain scenarios slight inaccuracies could lead to a player's body falling off a ledge on one person's view while they actually haven't fallen on their end. Now ragdoll positions have much tighter tolerances and the previously mentioned scenario should not happen anymore! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/b5a33ab7c2d05641c4d5692d16401a226e5e90b5.gif[/img]

[h2][i]Ragdolling With Weapons[/i][/h2]

Being knocked over used to leave your character literally empty handed. Now you hold on to your weapon when knocked over so you know when you shot a sniper or if they picked up one of the shotguns on the map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/8b7147432dcb00b6457718196272c153b554f7d1.jpg[/img]

Intruder is usually about stealth and cooperation, but sometime you just have to let out your inner wrestling star and slam someone with a chair. The good news is that now you can! By placing explosives or well-placed grenades you can launch chairs into enemies and take them out!

Jake and Clor have worked on the Map Maker in order to make it more accessible to people without as much knowledge in Unity. New scripts and activator updates make interactive level elements a breeze to add to your map. Player models and toolbars make it more intuitive to create and upload your maps to the workshop. notes.title: Intruder Update 1648 - Stats, XP, Game Modes, MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/cbf6f0d714ee85f6913fd5bbdb95aee579ff0e50.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=lqUWOk54c28;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Hello everyone and welcome to Intruder update build number 1648![/b][/h3]

In this update all agents now have a brand new player profile that contains stats, experience points, and more which can be seen at our brand new website [url=https://intruderfps.com/]IntruderFPS.com[/url]! Along with new profiles, this update contains new game modes on official maps and more tools for custom maps made with Intruder Map Maker.

[h2][i]Player Progression[/i][/h2]
When playing on ranked maps you'll notice the new [b]Round Summaries[/b] that will list your actions for that round including kills, arrests, captures, and more. This allows you to analyze your gameplay without spoiling the stealthiness of Intruder with a kill feed that can be found in many FPS games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/0ac10f6cfd4ea481e410e5c6af89895c622f28f7.jpg[/img]

Additionally, at the end of each match you will be able to see how much experience you gained from that match listed alongside your report for all rounds you played in the match. These [b]Match Summaries[/b] show you how much experience each action gives you, and as you'll probably find out yourself, kills aren't everything. Finally, you can see your level rise as you fill up the experience gauge. You no longer need to challenge your buddy to a 1v1 on Cliffside to prove your skill! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/34e56ec4c5e32d15ea160435dc75a71b4cda6918.gif[/img]

Your player level is now displayed in the teams menu alongside your username and reputation rating so you can gain some more intel on the enemy before you plan your strategies.


Thanks to the awesome work from long time Intruder veteran DukeOfSussex, we have a beautiful and intricate [url=https://intruderfps.com/]new website[/url] with player stats, news, rooms lists, and the development roadmap.

Check out your personal stats page or find other agents by using the search bar or through their in-game profile card!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/4d371811849fe9f87bfdec3d5f63d1b2ec85e3db.png[/img]

We are working on tracking more stats and adding more progression updates so please let us know what [u]you[/u] would like to see by chatting with us on [url=https://discord.gg/superbossgames]Discord[/url] or by leaving a comment on this article! 

[h2][i]New Game Modes[/i][/h2]

The room creation menu has been updated to include map voting and a filtered search option, but that's not all! The new website backend allows us to make changes more quickly and allows us to put out new content such as [b]Riverside B2 Alt[/b] or [b]Riverside B1 Push[/b].

[h3][i]Riverside B2 Alt[/i][/h3]

This mode is very similar to the default game mode, but with a few critical changes. Spawn locations have been altered so intruders spawn on the ground level of B1 and the guards spawn on the top floor of B2. The package locations have also been changed to B2 top floor Computer Lab and B2 basement Sample Room. Old strategies such as rushing Lab A or taking the vents to server room won't cut it anymore so it's up to you to find the optimal path to extract the package or create a devilishly devious rig!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/055c5ca7592ae61b8cf2638368c6a8df4e0958ee.png[/img]

[h3][i]Riverside B1 Push[/i][/h3]

This mode changes up Riverside even more by having the intruders spawn with the package. That's right, [i][u]the package[/u][/i], as there is only one to pick up. Intruders must escort this package from B2 Gallery to one of the two possible extracts located inside of B1. The closer extract is located behind the front desk in B1 Lobby and the further extract is located in the B1 Executive Office. While the Intruders may seem like they have the upper hand, the shortened round timer and single package allow the guards to use their tactics and force  the ball in their court.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/a5a05fa9c9395453373b65d8974c9ad8b5611a81.gif[/img]

[h3][i]But Wait, There's More[/i][/h3]

Like we mentioned earlier, we are now able to make additions at a faster pace and you can expect to see new game modes coming soon to the official maps you know and love. If you're reading this article right after it has been published then Mountainside Push is being tested and tweaked right now!

[h2][i]Map Maker Updates[/i][/h2]

Since the official maps are getting new modes, why not add a new mode to one of your custom maps with Intruder Map Maker version 2.04! 

[h3][i]Game Mode: Hack[/i][/h3]

Included in this update are computer network prefabs that you can drag into your scene. You can add up to 60 computer nodes arranged in any network layout you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/5c2f1ee65f586541048f0c6613dcd5cac6c815c8.gif[/img]

[h3][i]Game Mode: Raid[/i][/h3]

You can now add up to 10 packages and 10 capture points to your maps to allow for more diverse and exciting map ideas. You can even combine raid and hack by adding a computer network to your map alongside the packages!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/676edb2f125cce89aec7e54655fd631e0a7fa1e1.gif[/img]

 [h3][i]Activators and Doors[/i][/h3]

Activators can now be used to lock or unlock doors in your map which can spice up gameplay and dynamically force strategy changes.

[h2][i]Bug Fixes and QoL Improvements[/i][/h2]

These changes include, but are not limited to:
[list]
[*] New briefcase icon appears as part of your HUD when you have the package
[*] New sound effect when you pick up or drop the briefcase
[*] Riverside elevator floor display working again
[*] End of match observe cam placement fixed for custom maps
[*] Lockpick tooltip removed for doors which can't be lockpicked
[*] Round timer display bug fixes
[*] Music added to tutorial
[*] Getting a draw on practice rounds no longer repeats the practice round

[*] Various tiny UI bug fixes
[*] Mouse sensitivity bug when getting CS gassed and quitting fix
[*] Slowmo mode will no longer affect the map vote screen
[*] Various workshop map loading and server connection fixes
[*] Cliffside roof security system upgrade
[/list]

[code][h3][b]DiD yOu KnOw ThAt!?[/b][/h3]After a package has been dropped you can use explosives to blast it to a more convenient (or inconvenient) location![/code]

BUT WAIT, there's more!

[h3][i]Intruder Chrome & Firefox notifications extension RERELEASED[/i][/h3]

The new Intruder notifications extension is out (and finally back on FireFox!) along with the new website! This new version is packed with way more features including:

notes.title: Update 1489 - New Oceanside & Smoother Gunplay!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/73ce002432508e84b54aa78ee6cd27a2f0ed9593.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Hello everyone and welcome to Intruder update build number 1489![/b][/h3]
This update brings changes focused on making gameplay and gunplay feel smooth and consistent. There is also an update to Oceanside which you can learn more about down below!

[h2][i]Aiming and Shooting[/i][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/1f119df580adea7fc65060ac7c014b1cc99eb57a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/047b174fce7698a36e3928d7df90de37b496bd5d.gif[/img]
[list][*] When aiming down the sights of a weapon your field of view will lower smoothly rather than the instant shift present in previous builds. This should make it easier to stay focused on a target when switching from hip fire to aiming down the sights.
[*] Gun sway after aiming down sights has been greatly reduced making it easier to lock onto an enemy and take the shot before it's too late.
[*] A new option to choose whether or not your sensitivity is lowered when you aim down sights. (default from older builds is to have this enabled)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/22c6505948901a3b8144d6b4ce7229dfe7578ff5.png[/img]
[*] FOV has been increased from 70 degrees vertical to 74 degrees vertical (106 degrees horizontal on 16:9). 
[*] Default framerate is now uncapped with vsync turned off for extremely smooth aiming and shooting. Check the graphics options menu.
[*] Shooting an enemy or getting shot now has a distinct and gruesome hit sound along with a spray of blood indicating where the shot hit. Use this to your advantage to deduce where you or your teammate are getting shot from or confirming your own shots. Listen closely to the video below:
[previewyoutube=15yYgkdj3Tw;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] Tooltip for focusing while aiming down sights updated to display the correct keybind for players who use hold ADS instead of toggle ADS.
[/list]
[h2][i]Energy and Motion[/i][/h2][list]
[*] Walking no longer reduces the rate of energy recovery so you don't need to stop and go in order to keep your energy up. Crouch-walking and running still drain your energy, but you can transition to walking instead of having to stop and rest.
[*] The amount of energy lost from shooting while moving has been lowered somewhat so you can take some shots while motion without draining all of your energy.
[*] Dropshotting in Intruder is now a thing of the past! If you drop to prone immediately after shooting or sprinting it will take longer for you to take your weapon back out to engage with the enemy.
[/list]   
[h2][i]General Changes[/i][/h2][list]
[*] Dead bodies no longer spawn when someone joins a match mid-round. No more spooky bodies to startle you as you sneak out with the print room package!
[*] Hand signal sound priority has been fixed so it doesn't get drowned out on noisy maps. 
[*] The default match mode is now best 3 or 5 rounds per set before a team switch on all maps except Mountainside.
[*] The Mountainside round timer has been reduced to 10 minutes.
[*] The LMS game mode now allows you to join any team regardless of team balance.
[*] The dreaded "Cliffside bug" as it were will now ask all players to reconnect. Auto-reconnect probably coming in the future.
[/list]
[h2][i]Oceanside Update[/i][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/dbf34fb614c15cc3d63be7bdd0ecc79346bfd9dc.jpg[/img]
The new Oceanside update keeps the map we all know and love, but gives it a facelift with new lighting, sightlines, and sounds! Check out this video:
[previewyoutube=AqLbeGsdKZw;full][/previewyoutube]
We've also made some changes and additions:
[list]
[*] Shotgun added
[*] Sun added
[*] Round timer added
[*] Fixed collisions
[*] Wall chunking from bullet hits
[*] Trees actually light
[*] Bedroom ready for action
[*] Replaced those old crappy doors with the lovely new doors
[*] Getting hit by the van will kill you now
[*] Fixed water height issues
[*] Added reverb to cave
[*] Added nice light in guard spawn
[/list]

New lighting isn't all that's coming to Oceanside. Look out for new models and assets in the future. More Oceanside update notes over on the workshop at: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1813453028]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1813453028[/url]

notes.title: Update 1429 - Totally new UI, Inventory, and More!
notes.notes:

[*] Ammo is now a separate item in your inventory allowing you to drop and share.
[*] Use drop button or right click to drop.
[*] Attachments like the red dot are now removable (removable pistol suppressor coming soon).

[list]
[*] Support crisp looking UI up to 4k resolution
[*] Make UI changes and additions much, much easier
[*] Have faster rendering performance
[*] Allow more options for scaling and customization in the future
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1297 + Steam Workshop Support!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/fa8834c5a691470b1271f47043133413ff65e45d.png[/img]
Hey guys, Ryguytheguy here again with a look at an exciting new update 1297 that has been in the works for quite some time now, Steam Workshop support! With this new version of Intruder, players can upload, download, discuss, and rate maps made by the community. A few bugs were also patched including the microphone boost bug. Now the microphone boost will not reset between rounds and you can leave it at the preferred setting.

The old system of adding your own maps meant that you had to go on discord or the steam forums to tell people about your map. Feedback was scattered across different platforms and was easily buried by other conversations. This also meant that it was difficult to find good maps. Even though many amazing maps were being uploaded by talented mapmakers, they went unplayed due to the fact that people did not even know they existed.

With the Steam Workshop you can quickly browse maps based off of popularity, users, or tags to find the exact map that you'd like to play. If you want to play a custom map, just head over to the workshop and subscribe to the map and you'll be able to play. There is even a button to open the workshop and add maps right in the 'create server' menu.

For many of you, this is all you need to know about the update; however, if you want to help improve the community and see your creations in-game then keep reading as I break down how to upload your very own map to Intruder using Intruder Map Maker!


[h1]Introduction to Intruder Map Maker[/h1]
The Intruder Map Maker (or IntruderMM) can be used to create custom maps for Intruder using Unity. The IntruderMM package allows you to create, test, and upload maps to Intruder and has plenty of prefabs to help you get started. For the most simple maps you can simply drag and drop prefabs and models into the Unity scene and have a functional map that is ready to play. This does not limit your creative genius, however, and with a bit of dedication you can create a map that has custom features, rules, and game modes! If you want to see some of the amazing maps I previously mentioned, check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/518150/announcements/detail/1609389464848468980]Community Map Showcase[/url] that was posted a while back. There has never been a better time to make your own map for Intruder, so let's get started!  

[h1]How to Get Started[/h1]
[b]Step 1 - Installation[/b]
Install Unity version 5.6.5p4 (linked at the bottom of this article), and install both Mac and Windows build platforms. Make sure that the correct Unity version is listed in the top left of the Unity window, and that the project is also using the same version. Next you need to install the IntruderMM package (also at the bottom of this article) to get started.

[b]Step 2 - Setup[/b]
Open Unity. Start a new project and import the IntruderMM unity package. This will set you up with everything you need to start making your level. Just double click the package when you have your project open or use Assets->Import Package->Custom Package and select the IntruderMM package. You should see something similar to what is shown below. Make sure everything is selected and then press "import" to get the package.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/4ae7f61cc252138d93f4d794cf3135f02d8377c1.png[/img]

[b]Step 3 - Making a Map[/b]
You can now begin making your level. Be sure to grab a SpawnA (guards) and SpawnB (intruders) from the Prefabs folder and place them in your level to choose where your guards and intruders will spawn. The prefabs folder is full of great things to get your levels started such as doors, windows, goal points, briefcases, and much more. While it is a bit outdated, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-u2AJYsBbDs]this tutorial[/url] should get you started. You no longer need Unity Pro to upload maps! Please feel free to ask questions and learn with the community by following the link to our Discord server in the 'Help and Feedback' section at the bottom of this post.

[b]Step 4 - Testing[/b]
Test your level. Navigate to the Intruder menu at the top of your window to start testing your map. Selecting Intruder->Play Scene in Intruder will allow you to hop in game and experience your map from a player's perspective. If this is your first time, you will be prompted to find your copy of Intruder.exe or Intruder.App, and they will most likely be in the locations shown below. If you are unsure where Intruder is installed, right click on the Intruder in your Steam library, choose ‘properties’. Go to the ‘Local Files’ tab and choose ‘Browse Local Files’ to find the directory you need. 

[code]Where to find Intruder:
Mac: Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Intruder/Intruder.app
Windows: \\SteamLibrary\\steamapps\\common\\Intruder\\Intruder.exe[/code]

[b]Step 5 - Uploading[/b]
Intruder->Map Upload will allow you to upload your map and set tags. If it's the first time uploading the map, leave the Workshop ID blank. If you are editing a map that you previously uploaded, enter the ID of the map in the Workshop ID field. If you do not know what the ID of the map is you can find it by browsing to the Workshop page for the map. The ID is at the end of the URL for your map on the workshop. Set the visibility to public when you want other people to see and be able to play your map, or keep it private if you are not ready to share it yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34530436/d07c336390c7610fb70384bdce1e9c79490ddc97.png[/img]

[b]Step 6 - Steam Workshop[/b]
Now that you have a map uploaded you can start to add features from the workshop. If you navigate back to the Intruder->Map Upload option in Unity you will see that you can now add tags. these tags include:
[list]
[*]Hack - Maps that feature hacking as part of the objective. e.g. Cliffside
[*]Raid - Maps that feature a raid to secure a package as part of the objective. e.g. Riverside
[*]In-Dev - Maps that are still being developed.
[*]Training - Maps that teach players or let them practice skills. e.g. Sniper Range
[*]Silly - Maps that are meant for silly or otherwise non-serious gameplay. e.g ohnoscoobs
[*]Custom Tuning - Maps where gameplay tuning has been changed. e.g. King Of The Hill
[*]Custom Mission - Maps where the objective has been custom created by the mapmaker e.g. ArkhangelSK
[/list] 
You can also add contributors if you worked on a map with someone else. You can also edit the title, description, images, and links that you have on the workshop page. Finally, you can check out what people have to say about your map in the comments tab or start a discussion in the discussions tab on your workshop page.

Now your map is a part of Intruder, congratulations and thank you for your contribution to the Intruder community!
